services.name: All Charters
services.desc: Miss Susie Charters offers several Chesapeake Bay fishing charter types, including Chesapeake Bay fishing trips targeting rockfish, bluefish, and Spanish mackerel; specialized blue catfish charters on the Potomac River; and light tackle trophy trips for species like Cobia and Red Drum. Private group and walk-on options are available for anglers of all experience. What makes us unique is our adaptability. Based on the season and where the fish are biting, we depart from key locations such as Solomons Island, Pasadena, National Harbor, and Ridge, Maryland. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Our Fishing Charters from National Harbor puts you on the water fast. Sitting along the Potomac River just minutes from Washington, DC, this departure point gives anglers from the DC metro area direct access to some of the most exciting fishing on the East Coast - without a long drive to the Bay. Miss Susie Charters launches from Tantallon Marina in National Harbor, giving your group a convenient and productive starting point for Potomac River and Chesapeake Bay fishing. Whether you are chasing rockfish, targeting trophy blue catfish, or looking for a fun group outing close to the city, our professional captains bring the gear, the knowledge, and the results. quotes.author: Wilbur Wampler
quotes.text: This was the fourth time I went with Miss Susie in two years. I really enjoy getting out on the water and reeling in fish. Every time I was out we got our limit of fish. The captains and mates have all done a wonderful job. Greg has always been great scheduling my trips. The last trip landed on a stormy day so we had to reschedule but that went smoothly also. They are a great group to work with.

quotes.author: Ish D
quotes.text: Absolutely amazing!! Great staff , great experience. We stood seniors at our assisted living community and it was very safe and very well done can’t say how appreciative we are for the crew and captain Greg!!!

quotes.author: Kenneth Lloyd
quotes.text: Today we fished on the Miss Susie 2 with Captain Greg and mate Corey. We had the best time. Captain Greg really put us on the fish. We will definitely be back
